chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Razzaz al-Kufi narrated to me from Muhammad ibn 'Isa ibn 'Ubayd, from someone whose name he mentioned, from Abul Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:

Say in Baghdad: Peace be upon you, O Wali of Allah. Peace be upon you, O Hujjah of Allah. Peace be upon you, O Nur of Allah in the darkness of the earth. Peace be upon you, O one about whom Allah manifested His affair. I have come to you, knowing your right, opposing your enemies. So intercede for me with your Lord, O my Master. He said: And supplicate to Allah and ask for your need.

He said: And greet with this Abi Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him). And he said: When you intend the Ziyarah of Musa ibn Ja'far and Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him), perform Ghusl, cleanse yourself, and wear your two pure garments, and visit the grave of Abul Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) and Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him).

And say when you arrive at the grave of Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him): Peace be upon you, O Wali of Allah. Peace be upon you, O Hujjah of Allah. Peace be upon you, O Nur of Allah in the darkness of the earth. Peace be upon you, O one about whom Allah manifested His affair. I have come to you as a visitor, knowing your right, opposing your enemies, befriending your friends. So intercede for me with your Lord, O my Master.

Then ask for your need, then greet Abi Ja'far Muhammad al-Jawad with these words, and begin with Ghusl and say: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad ibn Ali, the Imam, the Righteous, the Pious, the Pure, the Pleased, the Pleasing, and Your Hujjah upon those above the earths and those under the dust. Send a plentiful, complete [growing], pure, blessed, continuous, frequent, successive blessing, like the best of what You have sent upon any of Your friends.

Peace be upon you, O Wali of Allah. Peace be upon you, O Nur of Allah. Peace be upon you, O Hujjah of Allah. Peace be upon you, O Imam of the Believers [O Imam of the Believers and Heir of the Prophets]. Peace be upon you, O Caliph of the Prophets and Progeny of the Successors. Peace be upon you, O Nur of Allah in the darkness of the earth. I have come to you as a visitor, knowing your right, opposing your enemies, befriending your friends. So intercede for me with your Lord, O my Master. Then ask for your need, for verily it will be fulfilled, if Allah wills, the Exalted.

He said: And say at the grave of Abul Hasan (peace be upon him) in Baghdad, and it suffices in all sites to say: Peace upon the Wali of Allah and His chosen ones. Peace upon the Trustees of Allah and His loved ones. Peace upon the Supporters of Allah and His Caliphs. Peace upon the places of knowing Allah. Peace upon the dwellings of the remembrance of Allah. Peace upon the manifestations of the command of Allah and His prohibition.

Peace upon the callers to Allah. Peace upon those settled in the pleasure of Allah. Peace upon those sincere in the obedience of Allah. Peace upon those guiding to Allah. Peace upon those whose friend is a friend of Allah and whose enemy is an enemy of Allah, and those who know them have known Allah and those who ignore them have ignored Allah, and whoever holds fast to them has held fast to Allah, and whoever secedes from them has seceded from Allah.

I bear witness to Allah that I am peaceful to you, peace to whoever is peaceful with you and war to whoever wars with you. Believing in your secret and your public, entrusting all of that to you. May Allah curse the enemy of the family of Muhammad from the Jinn and mankind, and I dissociate myself to Allah from them. And may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

And this suffices in all the shrines, and you increase in sending blessings upon Muhammad and his family, and you name them one by one with their names, and you dissociate from their enemies, and you choose for yourself from the supplications and for the believers and the female believers.
ai.seo_question: What is the specific text and ritual procedure for visiting the graves of Imam Musa ibn Ja'far and Imam Muhammad ibn al-Hadi in Baghdad?
ai.summary: Compiled by Ibn Qulawayh, this hadith establishes the theological framework of *Ziyarah* as an act of recognizing divine authority (*Haqq*) and aligning with the Imamate, particularly emphasizing the intercessory role of the Imams in Baghdad. It prescribes ritual purity (*Ghusl*) and specific salutations that highlight the Imams as the 'Proof of God' (*Hujjat Allah*) and 'Light of God' (*Nur Allah*), reinforcing the Shia doctrine of *Tawalli* (loyalty) and *Tabarri* (disloyalty to enemies). The text also provides a universal formula for visiting other Imams, underscoring the continuity of the Imamate and the spiritual connection between the visitor and the divine through the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. Muḥammad ibn Ja’far Al-Razzāz Al-Kūfi narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā ibn ‘Ubayd, from someone whose name he mentioned, who said: Abul Ḥasan (Imam Hādi (a.s.)) said: Recite the following in Baghdad:                           Salām to you, O Walī of Allāh. Salām to you, O Allāh’s Decisive Proof.

Salām to you, O Allāh’s light in the darkness of the earth. Salām to you, O one about whom Allāh modified His Will.            I have come to you while I believe in your rights and I am the enemy of your enemies. Therefore, intercede for me with your Lord, O my master. Then supplicate to Allāh and ask for your needs.

Thereafter, recite the same Salām in the Ziyārah of Abī Ja’far, Muḥammad ibn ‘Ali (Imam Jawād (a.s.)).He (Imam Hādi (a.s.)) said: When you want to go to the Ziyārah of Musā ibn Ja’far (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) and Muḥammad ibn ‘Ali (Imam Jawād (a.s.)), cleanse yourself, perform Ghusl, wear your purified clothes, and then go the graves of Abil Ḥasan, Mūsā ibn Ja’far and Muḥammad ibn ‘Ali ibn Mūsā Al-Riďā (a.s.).

When you arrive at the grave of Mūsā ibn Ja’far (a.s.) say:                           Salām to you, O Walī of Allāh. Salām to you, O Allāh’s Decisive Proof. Salām to you, O Allāh’s light in the darkness of the earth. Salām to you, O one about whom Allāh modified His will.               I have come to you to perform your Ziyārah while I believe in your rights, I am the enemy of your enemies, and I befriend your friends. Therefore, intercede for me with your Lord, O my master.

Then ask for your needs. Say Salām to Abī Ja’far, Muḥammad ibn ‘Ali Al-Jawād (a.s.), ensuring that Ghusl has been performed, by saying:                     O Allāh! Send Your blessing on Muḥammad ibn ‘Ali, the righteous, the pious, the pure Imam, who is pleased with You and with whom You are pleased, and Your Decisive Proof on those who are on the earths and those under the dust.                (O Allāh! Send) an increasing, complete, purified, beautified, continuous, and a frequent blessing (on him) that is consecutive and greater than any of the blessings You have sent on any of Your friends.                                      Salām to you, O Walī of Allāh. Salām to you, O light of Allāh. Salām to you, O Allāh’s Decisive Proof.

Salām to you, O Imam of the believers and heir of the prophets. Salām to you, O Caliph of the prophets and O progeny of the successors. Salām to you, O Allāh’s light in the darkness of the earth.               I have come to you to perform your Ziyārah while I believe in your rights, I am the enemy of your enemies, and I befriend your friends. Therefore, intercede for me with your Lord, O my master.

Then ask for your needs, for verily, Allāh-Willing, they will be fulfilled.Imam (a.s.) said: Recite the following next to the grave of Abil Ḥasan (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) in Baghdad – and you can recite the same in all of the sites (of the infallibles (a.s.)):                Salām upon Allāh’s Divine Authorities and His Chosen Ones. Salām upon Allāh’s Loved Ones and His Trustees. Salām upon Allāh’s Supporters and His Caliphs.                 Salām upon the places in which Allāh can be known. Salām upon the houses in which Allāh is extolled. Salām upon those who manifest Allāh’s orders and His prohibitions.                       Salām upon the Ones who call (the people) toward Allāh. Salām upon the Ones who are settled firmly in that which pleases Allāh. Salām upon the Ones who are loyal in obeying Allāh. Salām upon the guides to Allāh.

Salām upon the Ones whom those who follow them have followed Allāh, those who antagonize them have antagonized Allāh, those who know them have known Allāh, those who ignore them have ignored Allāh, those who seek refuge with them have sought refuge with Allāh, and those who abandon them have abandoned Allāh.

I take Allāh as witness that I have submitted to you, I make peace with those who make peace with you, I antagonize those who antagonize you, I believe in that which is secret about you and that which is apparent about you, and I rely on you in all of this.             May Allāh’s curse be upon the enemies of the family of Muḥammad from among the Jinn and mankind and I seek nearness to Allāh by dissociating myself from them.

And may Allāh’s blessing be upon Muḥammad and his family. Imam (a.s.) added: This Ziyārah will suffice in all of the sites (of the infallibles (a.s.)). And (after reciting it), send blessings on Muḥammad (s.a.a.w.) and his family (a.s.) increasingly and name them one after the other and dissociate from their enemies. Then choose some supplications and pray for yourself and the believers from among the men and the women.
